# scqc-python: 3.10.22
# The CellBender denoiser's environment (`cellbender`): every package of its closure at one exact version.
# conf/env/install_cellbender.sh applies it with `pip install --no-deps`, so nothing is resolved at
# build time, and then compares every installed version with this file; a difference refuses the build.
#
# FOR LINUX x86_64 ONLY, glibc >= 2.28: torch's CUDA 12.1 build and the nvidia libraries it loads exist for
# no other platform. Three versions here are decisions, required by install_cellbender.sh whatever this
# file says - cellbender 0.3.2, torch 2.5.1, numpy 1.26.4 (that script's header says why). Every other
# version is what the resolution below chose on the day it ran, and is claimed to be nothing more.
#
# Resolved 2026-11-09 by uv 0.12.5, from those three, with
#   uv pip compile <the three> --python-version 3.10.22 --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 \
#     --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121 --index-strategy unsafe-best-match
# Change one of the three in install_cellbender.sh first, then re-run that and replace the pins below.
# Three pins have no wheel and are built by pip from source, all pure Python: jupyter-contrib-core,
# jupyter-contrib-nbextensions, loompy.
